g.text: Recorded CPU diagnostics · 8 active cells · finite reflecting domain · 0 or 2 Erlang phases
A: both mass sums evaluated in float64 from saved float32 states; zero errors omitted on the log axis.
B: identical constant drive μ=0.45, σ=0.60, b=0.55, reset=0.05; refractory mean τ=0.30.
C: each probability/count pair uses the same initial state and time window; killed survival is never normalized.
